title: billing.refund-recorded.v1
description: Money was paid back to the customer through a mode allowed for refunds, in the cashier's open session, against one source: a payment's advance not applied, or an invoice holding more than it charges. Identifiers and figures only.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

cashierSessionId.description: The cashier session it was recorded in.

customerId.description: The customer, the order's. An identifier and nothing more.

orderId.description: The order the money came from.

paymentId.description: The payment whose advance was paid back, where the source is an advance.

invoiceId.description: The invoice whose surplus was paid back, where the source is an invoice.

modeCode.description: The mode it was paid through.

amount.description: How much, to the paisa, in currency.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
